purpose: Source-only grouped diagnostic checklist before acquisition; source claims are not independently verified, no answer labels consulted.

source.title: 2023 Kentucky online sports betting sites: Best legal sportsbooks, promos, bonuses, mobile apps, how to bet
source.author: CBS Sports Staff

assertions.subject: Kentucky launch
assertions.assertion: Retail and online launched September 2023; governor reported over $250 million wagered and roughly 500,000 mobile accounts about one month after launch.

assertions.subject: Kentucky scope
assertions.assertion: Article claims no restrictions on sports or prop categories; professional, collegiate and international options. Preserve jurisdiction and 2023 date.

assertions.subject: Fanatics
assertions.assertion: Sportsbook opened in 2023; prior merchandise business; up to 5% FanCash usable for gear or further bets.

assertions.subject: Fanatics menu
assertions.assertion: Odds boosts, Same Game Parlays and trending bets.

assertions.subject: FanDuel
assertions.assertion: DFS history; self-claimed America’s number one; odds boosts, parlay insurance and big-win bonuses.

assertions.subject: DraftKings
assertions.assertion: DFS history; pick-em and props pools, live bets, cross-sport parlays and moneylines.

assertions.subject: BetMGM
assertions.assertion: Resort/casino history; mobile sports; self-claimed king of parlays; boosted bets, in-game betting and SGPs.

assertions.subject: Caesars
assertions.assertion: Properties from Atlantic City to Las Vegas; sports and casino app; odds boosts, parlays, SGPs and Quick Picks.

assertions.subject: bet365
assertions.assertion: UK/Europe history, selected US states; personalized display; pre-match and in-play football, baseball and basketball.

assertions.subject: Selection criteria
assertions.assertion: Article recommends comparing bonuses, rewards, odds and markets; each sportsbook sets its own lines; reported practice of comparing multiple sites.

assertions.subject: FanCash rates
assertions.assertion: 1% straight bets, 3% parlays, 5% same-game parlays; redeem bonus bets or merchandise on Fanatics.com.

assertions.subject: Fanatics Discover
assertions.assertion: Discover combines marquee games, trending bets, promotions and rewards.

assertions.subject: DraftKings rewards
assertions.assertion: Most wagers earn points redeemable for free bets, merchandise or DFS entries; new-customer $5 bet yields $200 free bets at source date; profit boosts including SGPs.

assertions.subject: FanDuel rewards
assertions.assertion: Explicitly no rewards program at source date; live and SGP profit boosts; favorable interface judgment is attributed.

assertions.subject: BetMGM offer
assertions.assertion: First real-money loss credited in bonus bets up to $1,500; conditional bonus despite risk-free marketing wording; smaller token limits and rewards redeemable for MGM Resort credit.

assertions.subject: Caesars offer
assertions.assertion: New customers receive up to $1,000 bonus bets after first-bet loss; wagering credits usable at properties; home-state team boosts.

assertions.subject: bet365 offer
assertions.assertion: Bet $1, get $365 offer at source date; SGP selection described as smaller; rare leagues and sports covered.

assertions.subject: Kentucky law chronology
assertions.assertion: March 31, 2023 legalization; 34th legal state and 25th with online/mobile access; retail September 7 and online September 28.

assertions.subject: Kentucky forecast
assertions.assertion: Over $1 billion handle by end of 2023 is a forecast, not a realized total.

assertions.subject: Fanatics platforms
assertions.assertion: iOS/Android; FanCash, bettable search, Discover, cash outs, signup, deposits and Withdrawal Tracker.

assertions.subject: FanDuel platforms
assertions.assertion: iOS/Android, desktop/mobile web; quick bets, deposits, horse racing, casino, cash outs and payouts.

assertions.subject: DraftKings platforms
assertions.assertion: iOS/Android, desktop/mobile web; casino, withdrawals and deposits.

assertions.subject: BetMGM platforms
assertions.assertion: iOS/Android, desktop/mobile web; deposits/withdrawals, round-the-clock access and secure transaction claims.

assertions.subject: Caesars platforms
assertions.assertion: iOS/Android, desktop/mobile web; Caesars Rewards, casino and Quick Picks.

assertions.subject: bet365 platforms
assertions.assertion: iOS/Android, desktop/mobile web; cash outs, personalization, alerts, editing bets, My Teams, search and sports stats.

assertions.subject: Kentucky Wildcats basketball
assertions.assertion: Eight national titles; John Calipari coach since 2010 as reported; four Final Fours during tenure; 2012 title; 2,021–637 all-time record claimed best.

assertions.subject: Kentucky Wildcats football
assertions.assertion: SEC membership; twelve bowl appearances since 2006.

assertions.subject: Louisville basketball
assertions.assertion: 2013 title; ten Final Fours; 1,726–874 record ranked twelfth.

assertions.subject: Louisville football
assertions.assertion: Source says 2013 Heisman winner Lamar Jackson; ACC transition in 2014; seven AP Top 25 finishes since 2004. Preserve attribution rather than silently correcting.

assertions.subject: Western Kentucky football
assertions.assertion: Former Division I-AA/FCS; fully FBS in 2009; nine winning seasons since.

assertions.subject: Western Kentucky basketball
assertions.assertion: 23 NCAA tournaments; 1,622–720 all-time record ranked fourteenth.

assertions.subject: Kentucky professional sports
assertions.assertion: No Big Four teams within Kentucky; nearby Bengals popular; Colts and Titans a short drive from parts of the state.

assertions.subject: Bengals history
assertions.assertion: Marvin Lewis: seven playoff appearances in 2005–15; Burrow and Chase led 2021 Super Bowl appearance and 2022 AFC title game as reported.

assertions.subject: Reds and Cardinals
assertions.assertion: Reds described as Kentucky’s most popular MLB team; St. Louis Cardinals following especially in western Kentucky.

assertions.subject: Reds history
assertions.assertion: Titles in 1975, 1976 and 1990; no advance past NLCS since; 2023 playoff push reported, not final qualification.

assertions.subject: Spread example
assertions.assertion: Hypothetical Kentucky -7.5 against Louisville: Kentucky covers by winning by eight or more; Louisville covers by winning or losing by seven or fewer.

assertions.subject: Moneyline example
assertions.assertion: Hypothetical Kentucky -200 and Florida +200; stakes of $200/$100 for profits of $100/$200 conditional on winning. Not actual odds.

assertions.subject: Outright
assertions.assertion: Choose one athlete or horse to win an event; definition, not actual wager.

assertions.subject: Total example
assertions.assertion: Hypothetical Kentucky–Louisville total of 125.5; article’s Over 126/Under 125 wording is potentially imprecise. No actual result supplied.

assertions.subject: Player props
assertions.assertion: Source counts Kentucky among eighteen states allowing collegiate athlete props; projected stats include touchdown passes and three-pointers; dated claim.

assertions.subject: Underdog and favorite
assertions.assertion: Odds-based lower/higher win likelihood and typical return tradeoff; not guarantees.

assertions.subject: Consensus odds
assertions.assertion: Source describes an average of available markets; sites vary by action and interpretation of information.

assertions.subject: Futures
assertions.assertion: Season wins, championship and MVP markets compared with game-level markets.

assertions.subject: Parlay
assertions.assertion: Two or more legs must all win; hypothetical $100 three-leg wager at 6:1 gives $600 profit if successful.

assertions.subject: Juice
assertions.assertion: Aliases vig/vigorish; operator charge; source claims -110 on both sides means a 10% rake. Retain as an article claim, not a verified calculation.

assertions.subject: Push
assertions.assertion: Neither side wins and stake is returned; hypothetical total of 44 with exactly 44 combined points.

assertions.subject: Live betting
assertions.assertion: Real-time quarter outcomes, individual statistics and updated spreads/totals.

assertions.subject: Other states
assertions.assertion: Ohio, New York and Arizona named as sports-betting states at the source date.

negative_checks: Deduplicate repeated marketing paragraphs; preserve distinct reward rates, eligibility and redemption targets.
Jurisdiction and availability statements are dated source claims, not verified current law.
Examples are hypothetical, not completed transactions or game outcomes.
Do not silently repair potentially incorrect dates, records, arithmetic or unavailable linked terms from outside knowledge.
